title: Fahrenheit to Celsius
description:
Convert 100 degrees Fahrenheit to Celsius. The formula is:

```
C = (F - 32) * 5 / 9
```

Print the result rounded to 2 decimal places.

**Expected output:**
```
37.78
```
starterCode:
f = 100
# Convert to Celsius and print with 2 decimal places
hint: Use round(value, 2) or an f-string with :.2f to format to 2 decimal places.
